name: Kaplak
summary: In Razor Hill, Kaplak prepares young rogues for the Horde's quieter work. He teaches orc and troll students before sending them north to Orgrimmar.

sections.title: A Mentor in the Shadows
sections.body:
Kaplak trains new Horde rogues in Razor Hill. Though orcish custom favors open combat and roaring charges, he teaches skills that call for patience. His students learn to stalk unseen, pick locks, and strike from behind.

When they outgrow his lessons in Durotar's red ravines, Kaplak sends them north to Orgrimmar. There, senior guild operatives can deepen their craft.

faq.answer: Kaplak is an orc rogue trainer in Razor Hill, Durotar. He teaches early rogue skills to young orc and troll rogues from the Valley of Trials, then sends them to higher trainers in Orgrimmar.
Kaplak can be found in Razor Hill, Durotar's central settlement. He usually rests in or around the local barracks with other class trainers.
Kaplak guides rogue adventurers toward advanced trainers and assignments. He may send them to find Therzok in Orgrimmar.

angles.text: As a young orc or troll rogue leaving the Valley of Trials, you can learn your first trade from Kaplak. Then he directs you to the covert networks in Orgrimmar.
As a member of the Horde, you can count on Kaplak to train scouts, spies, and assassins. They guard Durotar and work beyond ordinary battle lines.
